proposed_fixes.title: Image Resizer may not preserve the source modification timestamp consistently
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Timestamp capture and restoration around output encoding may be skipped on some output paths or affected by concurrent metadata writes, despite the keep-original-time setting.
plan: Trace the setting value and output-file timestamp through all resize/encode paths.
Restore the captured source timestamp after every successful output path when the setting is enabled.
Add a regression test that exercises the affected format and verifies output LastWriteTimeUtc.
verification: Resize the same image with keep-original-time enabled and verify the output file timestamp matches the source time.

comment.body: Thanks for the screenshots and confirming this was intermittent on v0.85.1. Current code captures the source write time when the option is enabled and restores it after output, so the remaining question is which path skips that step. Could you confirm the current version and provide one failing attempt’s source/output formats and whether you compared filesystem “Date modified” rather than embedded photo metadata?
